3.name: Hand of Healing, Hand of Harm & Implements of Mercy (Warrior of Mercy)
3.description: Spend Focus Points to heal with Unarmed Strikes or deal extra Necrotic damage, and gain proficiency in Insight, Medicine, and Herbalism Kit.

6.name: Physician's Touch (Warrior of Mercy)
6.description: Hand of Healing also ends Blinded, Deafened, Paralyzed, Poisoned, or Stunned; Hand of Harm inflicts the Poisoned condition without a save.

11.name: Flurry of Healing and Harm (Warrior of Mercy)
11.description: Use Hand of Healing for free during Flurry of Blows and trigger Hand of Harm without spending extra Focus Points while Flurry is active.

17.name: Hand of Ultimate Mercy (Warrior of Mercy)
17.description: Spend 5 Focus Points to restore a creature that died within 24 hours to life with 4d10 + WIS modifier HP.

hand_of_harm.name: Hand of Harm
hand_of_harm.hint: Once per turn on Unarmed Strike hit: spend 1 Focus Point to deal Martial Arts die + WIS mod extra Necrotic damage.

hand_of_healing.name: Hand of Healing
hand_of_healing.hint: Spend 1 Focus Point to restore Martial Arts die + WIS mod HP to a creature you touch.

3.name: Shadow Arts (Warrior of Shadow)
3.description: Gain Darkvision (or extend its range), learn Minor Illusion, and spend 1 Focus Point to cast Darkness that you can see through.

6.name: Shadow Step (Warrior of Shadow)
6.description: As a Bonus Action in Dim Light or Darkness, teleport up to 60 feet to another shadowy space and gain Advantage on your next melee attack.

11.name: Improved Shadow Step (Warrior of Shadow)
11.description: Spend 1 Focus Point when using Shadow Step to ignore the Dim Light or Darkness origin/destination requirement and follow immediately with an Unarmed Strike.

17.name: Cloak of Shadows (Warrior of Shadow)
17.description: Spend 3 Focus Points in Dim Light or Darkness to become Invisible and move through solid objects and creatures for 1 minute.

3.name: Elemental Attunement & Manipulate Elements (Warrior of the Elements)
3.description: Learn Elementalism and spend 1 Focus Point for 15-foot reach Unarmed Strikes dealing Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder damage with forced movement.

6.name: Elemental Burst (Warrior of the Elements)
6.description: Spend 2 Focus Points to unleash a 20-foot-radius Elemental burst dealing 3 Martial Arts dice of Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder damage.

11.name: Stride of the Elements (Warrior of the Elements)
11.description: While Elemental Attunement is active, gain a Fly Speed and Swim Speed equal to your Speed.

17.name: Elemental Epitome (Warrior of the Elements)
17.description: Gain Resistance to a chosen elemental type, +20 Speed during Step of the Wind leaving elemental bursts, and +1 Martial Arts die elemental damage once per turn.

elemental_burst.name: Elemental Burst
elemental_burst.hint: Action + 2 Focus Points: 20-ft-radius sphere DEX save vs 3 Martial Arts dice of Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder damage.

3.name: Open Hand Technique (Warrior of the Open Hand)
3.description: Whenever you hit with Flurry of Blows, impose Addle (preventing Opportunity Attacks), Push (15 ft on failed STR save), or Topple (Prone on failed DEX save).

6.name: Wholeness of Body (Warrior of the Open Hand)
6.description: As a Bonus Action, regain HP equal to your Martial Arts die + WIS modifier (WIS modifier uses per Long Rest).

11.name: Fleet Step (Warrior of the Open Hand)
11.description: Whenever you take a Bonus Action other than Step of the Wind, you can immediately take Step of the Wind as well.

17.name: Quivering Palm (Warrior of the Open Hand)
17.description: Spend 4 Focus Points on an Unarmed Strike to set lethal vibrations that deal 10d12 Force damage (half on CON save) when ended.

wholeness_of_body.name: Wholeness of Body
wholeness_of_body.hint: Bonus Action restores Martial Arts die + WIS mod HP (WIS mod uses per Long Rest).

quivering_palm.name: Quivering Palm
quivering_palm.hint: End lethal vibrations for 10d12 Force damage (half on successful CON save).
